verdict.rationale: AMD's spec page documents only part of the I/O picture: NVMe support including boot, RAID0 and RAID1 (storage), and up to 4 displays, which bears on dock and monitor planning. The evidence never states the PCIe generation or lane count, and external connectivity such as USB4 or Thunderbolt is not documented. That leaves most of what a developer needs to plan a build or dock setup unevidenced. Missing for 10: PCIe generation and lane count, USB4/Thunderbolt/external connectivity specs, storage interface bandwidth details, independent hands-on corroboration of I/O capabilities.
